task_fulfillment.rationale: The workbook supplies the requested tables, volume inputs, research citations and carrier recommendations, with consistent linked formulas. However, four distinct USPS numeric targets are outside tolerance. The operating exception explicitly authorizes non-standard service despite the standard-only request. Nationwide annual spend also relies on an unsupported negligible AK/HI-volume assumption. These require correction before operational use. No separate approval-routing section or companion artifact was supplied. Rendering, executed recalculation and human acceptance were not assessed; missing formula caches alone are not treated as failure.
